claims.head: Expect the Panthers to have the puck more
claims.body: At 5-on-5, the Panthers have been around the middle of the league at getting more of the chances than they give up, and the Blackhawks one of the worst. The ice should tilt the Panthers’ way, even if goaltending and bounces have the final say on the score.
claims.call: The Panthers get the bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances.

claims.head: The Panthers hit, the Blackhawks mostly don’t
claims.body: On physicality, Florida is the league’s best, but Chicago is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Panthers.

stakes: The Panthers go in tied for fifth in the Atlantic with 12 points, the Blackhawks eighth in the Central with 6 points.

CHI.head: The Blackhawks have a hill to climb
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

FLA.head: The matchup suits the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

items.text: The Panthers are newly without Jacob Markström, and have been without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
Sam Reinhart has five goals in six games against Chicago since 2023-24.
The Blackhawks have been without Bowen Byram since Oct 13.
Carter Verhaeghe is set to play his 500th NHL game.
